title: 20+ experts warned him in writing. He called it a "baseless cry."

scenes.voiceover: More than twenty of the world's leading submersible experts sent him a letter warning his sub could be catastrophic. He ignored it.
In March 2018, the Marine Technology Society sent Stockton Rush a letter, warning his experimental approach could lead to outcomes from minor to catastrophic.
This wasn't a rival trying to steal business. This was the exact community he claimed to be serving — people who loved deep-sea exploration, and wanted it to survive its own ambitions.
His answer never changed. He called warnings like this baseless cries of, quote, you are going to kill someone.
Five years later, the U.S. Coast Guard's own investigation would quote this exact letter, verbatim, as one of the clearest warnings ever ignored.
